_goal: Four characters to Lv. 60, which is what unlocks Normal Mode in Imaginarium Theater.
_note: Quantities and icons are read out of the per-phase ascension data in reference/data/char_*.json. Nothing here is hand-typed except the source of each material, which the character files do not record.
_bill: About 1,080,000 Mora and 200 Hero's Wit across all four. Lv. 50-60 alone is 854,125 EXP per character.

targets.name: Dahlia
targets.why: Eligible in November and December both — the rotation does not drop her.

targets.name: Traveler
targets.why: Eligible in both months, and needs no world boss at all.

targets.name: Fischl
targets.why: Only ten levels, carries this season's +20% Opening Character bonus, and is a strong unit outside the Theater.

targets.name: Lisa
targets.why: Shares a boss with Fischl, so she is nearly free once Fischl is done. November only.

groups.title: Just go and claim it
groups.note: Brilliant Diamond comes only from Adventure Rank rewards — 3 at AR 25, 2 each at AR 26, 28 and 30, which is exactly the 9 the Traveler needs. You are AR 45, so all of them are already unlocked. Check whether they are sitting unclaimed before you farm anything else.

groups.title: Electro Hypostasis
groups.note: Drops the boss material AND the gem, so one boss finishes Fischl and Lisa together.

groups.title: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device
groups.where: Atocpan, Natlan — indwell a Koholasaurus and swim southwest
groups.note: Also drops both halves of what Dahlia needs, and about 2.5 accumulators a clear. Cryo is roughly twice as effective against its Flow Momentum gauge — bring Skirk. The same boss later feeds Escoffier, so nothing farmed here is wasted.

groups.title: Gathering — all of it in Mondstadt
groups.where: Free, no resin. Every one has a mapped route that assumes you teleport.
groups.note: Specialties respawn on a 48-hour timer, so start these first and let them tick while you do everything else.

items.name: Valberry
items.warn: Only 26 pins on the whole map against 20 needed — this is the tightest item here. Expect two passes across the respawn timer.

groups.title: Common enemy drops
groups.note: These accumulate on their own while you do anything else. Only chase them if you come up short.
